in_hebrew.name: Heyes
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Heyes הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'χήσ', meaning 'grace' or 'gift from God'. In Christian tradition, the name Heyes symbolizes God's unending love and favor.

in_greek.name: Ἑῖος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'heis', which means 'one', 'alone', 'single'. The name 'Heyes' in Greek would mean 'one who is a guest' or 'one who is a foreigner'. In the New Testament, this name is borne by several characters, including Heyes the centurion in Matthew 8:5-13.

in_latin.name: Heyes
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's grace
in_latin.long_meaning: Heyes est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'χήσ', meaning 'grace' or 'gift from God'. In Christian tradition, the name Heyes symbolizes God's unending love and favor.
